notes: Read SKILL.md in full (the only file). Kubernetes hardening manifests: a namespace enforcing the restricted Pod Security Standard, a pod securityContext (non-root, seccomp RuntimeDefault, read-only root FS, dropped capabilities), default-deny plus allow-web NetworkPolicies, a least-privilege read-only Role/RoleBinding, and best-practice bullets.
No commands, installs, credentials, or network access; the YAML is configuration the user applies to their own cluster.

The default-deny NetworkPolicy blocks all ingress and egress (including DNS) for every pod in the namespace until allow rules are added; the sample allow-web policy only covers ingress, so users need egress/DNS rules before applying it to a live namespace. Related Skills links `../../../devops/orchestration/kubernetes-ops/` and `../container-hardening/` (SKILL.md:128-129) are optional sibling skills.
